newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jardine group shares run on revaluation.
newsitem.headline: Jardine group shares run on revaluation.

text.p: Shares in the Jardine Matheson's group of companies listed in Singapore were traded heavily on Friday as funds and broking houses revalued the stocks upwards, dealers said.

At 0220 GMT, Hongkong Land rose another US$0.16 to US$2.94 on top volume of 5.7 million shares. Others in the group also saw good volumes, with Dairy Farm, up US$0.04 to US$0.675, Jardine Matheson, up by US$0.35 to US$6.60 and Jardine Strategic, which rose US$0.24 to US$3.54.
Dealers said broking houses and funds had revalued Hongkong Land upwards on record property prices in Hong Kong.
"The buying fever has caused a chain reaction in the rest of the group," said an institutional dealer.
Dealers said the Jardines group has been boosted by its inclusion in the recently launched Business-Times Singapore Regional Index.
"The weightings of Jardine companies used to be high on fund managers' portfolios. Now that they are in the regional index, the play is back," said a dealer.
Other dealers said they expected Hongkong Land to head for US$3.50, at which level it would be fair value.
